objects.summary: Codex produces the P1/Q9 Astra lot-3 mission draft only, with SHA-256 756b4345...19d2. The mission is fail-closed: exact-object inventory, replay/adversarial testing, D2/15-item audit, known gaps, no lot-4 permissive evaluation, E_EFFECTIVE false unless separately proven, and no Owner/economic/merge/activation authority. L2-J references remain A_REMPLIR_APRES_Q8.

Controller reports P1 published byte-identically: recalculated SHA-256 matches Codex draft, no objection. Q9 still cannot launch Astra until Q8 creates L2-J references. Next pilot switches to Claude for Q7/Q8.

Owner supplies a token-efficiency operating policy: prefer cheaper models for repetitive inventory, compact checkpoints, bounded reads, limited subagents, no duplicate reviews. The same message explicitly says the precise conversation model/backend accounting could not be confirmed by its worker; pricing/backend assertions are contextual guidance, not repository-verified project evidence.

Codex persists an efficiency receipt: targeted responses, bounded reads, deterministic checks, checkpoint reuse, limited subagents; explicitly marks tariffs/quotas/models/backend metadata as unverifiable from the task and preserves zero Owner/execution/economic/merge authority.

Q7/L2-I reports bounded execution evidence: 279 legacy tests run with 276 pass and exactly 3 expected differences; 27/27 new tests pass; 22 evaluate_input_read calls against real root all refuse, no PERMIT/AUTHORIZED; network/subprocess/forbidden-file counts zero. Boundaries remain: VM not compared/qualified, real-config quarantine not demonstrated, one validate_binding on real tuple requires Astra/Owner interpretation, Q8 remains blocked.
Owner explicitly ratifies the requested A2 charter Owner-autonomy amendment. The comment alone gives ratification fact but not the amendment's full reserved-rights semantics.

Builder records the ratified autonomy amendment at commit 42d41e19.../blob ac4e26e7..., notes GitHub timestamp vs file timestamp mismatch, flags a governance gap: six A2 activation conditions were omitted from the reserved-rights list and could otherwise be changed by two agents. Proposed fix remains Owner decision. Explicit effect: no new reserved-right rights, real capital/live false, merge none, A2 not activated and E still ineffective.

cross_object_findings.finding: Q9 mission text was produced and byte-verified unchanged, but Astra launch remained blocked until Q8/L2-J existed. Drafting + hash verification != review execution.
Q7 contains actual bounded test execution and explicit negative/unknown boundaries. Legacy/new test success does not establish VM qualification, real-config permissive evaluation or A2 activation.

Owner ratified the autonomy amendment, but the follow-up records a concrete omission in reserved rights around six activation conditions. The amendment itself explicitly leaves A2 inactive and E ineffective; no product authority is inferred.
Token/model efficiency guidance is a valid operating preference, while claims about exact rates/backend/accounting remain unverified by the task and must not be elevated into repository fact.
